high_level_description: This image depicts a clothing store display featuring a black jacket with white lettering on the back. The jacket is displayed on a mannequin, which is positioned in front of a rack of clothes. The mannequin is wearing a gray hoodie underneath the jacket. The jacket has a bold, cursive white text that reads "Meet you later" across the back. The collar of the jacket is black with white trim, and the cuffs of the sleeves also have black and white trim. The jacket appears to be made of a lightweight material, suitable for casual wear or mild weather.
